SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP12:E14 0-100 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.
EP12:E17 0-1100 JULIANA: "You planted it!"
EP12:E16 0-1200 ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
EP12:E18 1200-3000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.
EP12:E19 1300-3200 CLARISSA: "Oh, dear sister..."
EP12:E20 3000-4200 CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
EP12:E22 3200-5600 CLARISSA: "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
EP12:E21 4200-5600 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.
EP12:E24 5600-8400 JULIANA: "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
EP12:E23 5600-8500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.
EP12:E25 8500-13200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.
EP12:E26 8600-13200 CLARISSA: "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
EP12:E27 13200-15000 CAMERA: Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.
EP12:E28 13300-14700 CLARISSA: "Perhaps I can give you one."
EP12:E29 15000-16900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.
EP12:E30 15400-16700 JULIANA: "What do you want?"
EP12:E31 16900-19800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.
EP12:E32 17200-19600 CLARISSA: "I want to see you crawl, sister."
EP12:E33 19800-25600 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.
EP12:E34 19900-25500 CLARISSA: "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
EP12:E36 25600-29900 CLARISSA: "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
EP12:E35 25600-30000 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.
EP12:E37 30000-31200 ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
EP12:E38 30000-34000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.
EP12:E39 30500-33800 CLARISSA: "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
EP12:E41 34000-36300 GERALD: "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
EP12:E40 34000-36400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.
EP12:E42 36400-38400 CAMERA: Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.
EP12:E43 36500-38300 CLARISSA: "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
EP12:E44 38400-42400 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.
EP12:E45 38600-42400 CLARISSA: "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
